name: id
description: The ID of the notification banner.

name: title
description:
The title that displays in the notification banner:
- if you do not set `variant`, `title.text` defaults to `"Important"`
- if you set `variant` to `"success"`, `title.text` defaults to `"Success"`
- if you set `title.text` or `title.html`, the defaults are ignored

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the title. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the title. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the title.

params.name: headingLevel
params.description: Optional alias for the title heading `level` option.

params.name: level
params.description: Optional heading level for the title. Defaults to `2`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the title.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the title.

name: heading
description: Heading to be used within the notification banner.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the heading.

params.name: href
params.description: If set, the heading will become a link.

params.name: level
params.description: Optional heading level for the heading. Defaults to `3`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the heading.

params.name: element
params.description: HTML element for the heading – for example, `"p"`. Defaults to the `level` option prefixed with `"h"`.

name: text
description: The text that displays in the notification banner. You can use any string with this option. If you set `html`, this option is not required and is ignored.

name: html
description: The HTML to use within the notification banner. You can use any string with this option. If you set `html`, `text` is not required and is ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire notification banner component in a `call` block.

name: variant
description: Optional variant of notification banner. You can use only `"success"` or empty values with this option. If you set `variant` to `"success"`, the notification banner sets `role` to `"alert"`. JavaScript then moves the keyboard focus to the notification banner when the page loads. If you do not set `variant`, the notification banner sets `role` to `"region"`.

name: role
description: Overrides the value of the `role` attribute for the notification banner. Defaults to `"region"`. If you set `variant` to `"success"`, `role` defaults to `"alert"`.

name: disableAutoFocus
description: If you set `variant` to `"success"`, or `role` to `"alert"`, JavaScript moves the keyboard focus to the notification banner when the page loads. To disable this behaviour, set `disableAutoFocus` to `true`.

name: classes
description: The classes that you want to add to the notification banner.

name: attributes
description: The HTML attributes that you want to add to the notification banner, for example, data attributes.
